about: THE RULES OF TRADE - how the markets work, the money of the time and where it goes, the tolls and the laws. A table the game reads (edit freely; the numbers are STARTING GUESSES TO TUNE). All prices are reckoned in silver: one 'd' is a denier of Charlemagne's new standard of 793/4 (about 1.7 g); each zone shows them in its own reckoning.

coins.name: deniers
coins.note: The Frankish penny. Charlemagne's reform of 793/4 made it heavier (about 1.7 g); struck at Dorestad, Quentovic and every royal mint.

coins.name: pennies
coins.note: Offa's broad pennies and the older sceattas of England and Frisia (about 1-1.3 g).

coins.name: dirhams
coins.note: Silver of the Caliphate, come north by the Volga and the Baltic; in the north it goes by weight, often cut.

coins.name: hacksilver
coins.note: Silver by weight: cut rings, ingots and broken jewellery, weighed on folding scales (counted in grams).

zones.name: the Frankish realm
zones.note: Only the king's deniers are good money; other coin and silver go to the mint at a loss. The king's toll (the tenth) is taken at Dorestad, Quentovic and the river tolls.

zones.name: the English kingdoms
zones.note: Offa's pennies are the money; foreign coin to the moneyer at a loss. Toll at London and the wics.

zones.name: the lands of weighed silver
zones.note: No coin of their own: all silver goes by weight on the scales, coins too (nicked and tested: a little is lost). The king's men take their due in kind (to come).

zones.name: the dirham lands
zones.note: The Caliphate's silver is the money from the Volga to Cordoba. The Khazars take a tenth on the river trade.

zones.name: the Empire of the Romans
zones.note: Gold nomismata and silver miliaresia (to come); the kommerkion takes a tenth.

laws.note: No byrnie may be sold out of the realm (Herstal, 779); no weapons or mail to the Slavs and Avars, on pain of losing all one carries (Thionville, 805). Frankish officers search ships at the borders.
Whoever sells arms or horses to the Northmen shall lose his life (Edict of Pitres, 864).
No horses to the Northmen, on pain of death (Edict of Pitres, 864).

Christians may not be sold out of the realm, nor to pagans, Jews or Saracens. Pagan Slavs are sold lawfully through Verdun to Spain. The Church abhors the trade; the Norse and Rus markets do not care.
Buying and selling holy relics is simony; selling a church's plate is sacrilege.

market._spread: the gap between what a market asks and what it pays (0.2: asks 10% over its price, pays 10% under)
market._stock_value: deniers' worth of a good a market keeps in stock for each step of its size times how strongly it makes the good
market._stock_minmax: units in stock, at least and at most
market._regen: the share of the gap back to its usual stock a market makes up each day (making, selling on, using up)
market._elasticity: how hard the price answers scarcity: price x (usual stock / stock) ^ this
market._price_minmax: the most scarcity or plenty move a price (times its usual)
market._appetite_value: deniers' worth of a good a market takes at a good price, for each step of its size times how keenly it wants it
market._glut_elasticity: how fast the price a market pays falls as you sell it more than it wants
market._glut_fade: the share of a glut used up each day
market._unwanted: what a market pays for a good it neither makes nor wants (times its value)
market._shock_fade: the share of a passing shortage or rush (a famine, a raid, a fair: the chronicle) that fades each day
market._cheap_dear: a good's price in its cheap and dear months (its 'cheap' and 'dear' in goods_793.json)

start._debt: deniers owed (eight pounds of silver) for the ship, to the count. Ruling 30 of 7 Oct 2026: it goes with SimRules.minMargin 0.25 (WorldSim.cs) or not at all; from a model, to be looked at again once the alpha is played
start._creditor: the key for the creditor's name in writing.json (yours to write)
start._due: the day the debt falls due: the next one after the start (29 September 793 for a game begun 1 May 793). In 793 it is a Sunday
start._work_share: THE BOAT'S WORK (8 Oct 2026): once the day has passed unpaid and the lender has said she works for him (the cards' flag wk_work), this share of everything she sells goes to the stick before it reaches the purse, until the stick is clean. Nothing is added to the debt.
start._due_days: only used when no calendar is known (tests, a level with no clock)
start._world_from: month-day the world's traders and markets start: they are stepped to the clock's start before the first frame, so no market is untouched on the player's first morning. Empty: they start with the player
